summary: ArgoCDDeploy 7843991 on phase/037-P3 binds jenkins-prd/destroy-stage alone to a Role in argocd-hooks (jobs get/create/delete, pods get/list, pods/log get: what vars/kubectl.groovy's Job steps call) and a Role in argocd-prd (applications get/list). The render gate pins both exactly, requires the one subject and refuses any binding that reaches jenkins-prd/default; eight mutations turned it red, and `kc project test` is green. P5's text now requires the Job manifest's argocd-hooks namespace, a Job name fresh per build (no patch), and only those kubectl steps.
